# Speech fixture

`jfk.wav` is the 16 kHz mono excerpt from John F. Kennedy's 1961 inaugural
address previously supplied by the removed vendor speech engine's samples.
It remains an independent test asset for Parakeet and Phonon-2 recognition.
Original sample source: https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/blob/master/samples/jfk.wav
